compatibility_rules: Do not pool historical groups 46--50, R3 groups 101--105, SF4 groups, V3 groups 41--45, or V3 CARLA groups 81--90 as a single independent sample.
Use F1 to justify B1 as a strong task-adapted reference, not as a V3 H1 capacity result.
Use F2 for the broad adaptive-versus-three-fixed frontier and F5 for the prospectively frozen best-model transfer test.
Use F3 only to test supervisor mechanism; authority-off is not a recommended controller.
All universal superiority, safety, equivalence and cross-map claims remain prohibited.

evidence_blocks.claim_boundary: one Town05 distribution; five independent groups; old 0.98%-to-100% mode-ranking headline withdrawn
evidence_blocks.design: B0 versus B1; groups 46--50; 20 rollouts; 315 overlapping windows; 5 paired groups
evidence_blocks.role: establishes the task-adapted B1 reference without using the withdrawn percentage accuracy

evidence_blocks.claim_boundary: five paired groups; exact sign-flip sensitivity is coarse; no pooling with V3 groups 81--90
evidence_blocks.design: B0/B1 x adaptive/fixed-aggressive/fixed-medium/fixed-conservative x two styles x groups 101--105
evidence_blocks.role: broad closed-loop frontier and historical transfer boundary

evidence_blocks.claim_boundary: authority-off is a mechanism stress test, not a viable deployment recommendation; no selective risk-policy masking demonstrated
evidence_blocks.design: B1 x adaptive/fixed-medium x authority on/off x two styles x ten groups
evidence_blocks.role: mechanism ablation for shared supervisor authority

evidence_blocks.claim_boundary: five retrospective held-out groups; H1--H3 scalar levels are not pooled with the older groups 46--50 foundation audit
evidence_blocks.design: 9 cells x 3 seeds; groups 1--35 fit, 36--40 selection/calibration, 41--45 retrospective held-out
evidence_blocks.role: capacity, information and matched architecture decomposition

evidence_blocks.claim_boundary: ten paired groups; prediction diagnostics differ, but physical interaction intervals cross zero; zero collisions are not safety proof
evidence_blocks.design: B1/P* x fixed-medium/adaptive x two styles x groups 81--90
evidence_blocks.role: prospective H4a/H4b test for frozen P* and risk

integrated_hypotheses.H1: At 1.0 s history, greater Transformer trainable capacity reduces held-out rollout-macro NLL with a coherent capacity trend.
integrated_hypotheses.H2: At matched large capacity, older explicit interaction tokens add predictive information beyond the current interaction state for both encoder families.
integrated_hypotheses.H3: At matched capacity and information, attention extracts more history value than an MLP, requiring a favourable history-gain interaction in addition to direct model gaps.
integrated_hypotheses.H4: Closed-loop utility: (a) validation-selected P* retains its prediction advantage and improves CARLA completion/separation relative to B1; (b) adaptive risk offers a better efficiency-separation operating point than fixed risk in the give-way task.

scientific_scope: right-hand-traffic Town05 left-turn give-way; ego yields to an opposing straight-through target
